desc: Ideation: reduce problem to longest palindromic suffix via KMP on rev(S)+'#'+S; answer = S + reverse(S[:n-q])
Implement final solve() using bytes for speed (bytes indexing yields ints), tight KMP loop with local variables, O(n) time/memory
Verify on samples and edge cases (n=1, palindrome input q=n → answer S, all-distinct chars q=1)
Ensure I/O uses sys.stdin.buffer/sys.stdout.buffer and code is enclosed in required delimiters
